entries.why: NetworkManager checks that this network reaches the internet, and spots a sign-in page such as a hotel's, by loading a test page from fedoraproject.org.
entries.evidence: bazzite-tower r10: idle and after update, /usr/bin/NetworkManager to fedoraproject.org port 80 over tcp and tcp6

entries.why: chronyc asks the local time service (chronyd) how it is doing. It only talks to this computer.
entries.evidence: bazzite-tower r10: idle and after update, /usr/bin/chronyc to 127.0.0.1 and ::1 port 323 over udp and udp6

entries.why: Flatpak downloads app updates and app information from Flathub.
entries.evidence: bazzite-tower r10: after flatpak update --appstream, /usr/bin/flatpak to dl.flathub.org port 443 over tcp6 (held, so the update timed out)
